tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: dam chos snying po skor lnga las: chos skyong dgongs 'dus snying po bzhugs:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ seng chen 'gying ba lta bu'i yi ge / bla ma ye shes mgon por 'dud: 1$0000250de nyid sgrub pa'i man ngag ni: sbyor dngos rjes kyis nyams su blang: sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas:1$0000300 hūm̐: ye shes mgon po'i dkyil 'khor du: bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba la: 'byung po rdul gyis mi tshugs pas: log par 'dren pa phyir dengs shig: drag sngags thun gyi rol mos bskrad: hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs mtshams mtshon cha'i gur: skar ltar 'khrugs shing ser ltar 'khrigs: glog ltar 'khyug cing thog ltar 'beb: gtum drag rol pas mtshams bcad do: hūm̐: ye shes me rlung chu 'phros pas: dngos 'dzin dri ma thams cad gtor: dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas dbus: drag po bhañdza'i snod yangs su: dgra bgegs bkug cing bsgral pa yi: sha lnga bdud rtsi zhu ba'i bcud: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis: ye shes bdud rtsi spyan drangs bstims: sha khrag rus pa'i bza' btung dang: dur khrod rol pa'i bkod pa sogs: mchod sprin spyan gzigs bsam mi khyab: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rnam dag chos dbyings khyab brdal chen po la: snying rje'i rang mdangs hūm̐ yig 'bar ba las: 'od 'phros snod bcud sbyangs nas tshur 'dus pa: 'byung ba rim brtsegs dur khrod sa gzhi la: mthing nag gru gsum gzhal yas khang gi dbus: padma nyi ma ro yi gdan steng du: hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ mtshan 'phro 'du las: bdag nyid ye shes mgon po he ru ka: mthing nag dbu dgu phyag ni bco brgyad kyis: 'bar ba'i mtshon cha 'dzin nas zhabs brgyad bgrad: dpal dang dur khrod chas kyis 'jigs par brgyan: kro dhī shwa rī gri thod 'dzin dang 'khril: ye shes me 'bar rdo rje'i thog ser 'beb: thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' hūm̐ yig las: 'od 'phros snang srid 'khor lo rtsibs bcur 'bar: hūm̐ bcu 'phros pas khro rgyal gri thod can:

phur pa'i dbal can gdon bgegs snying la zug: ye shes me dang mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshubs: phra men mang pos gsang ba'i phrin las mdzad: oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: ma ma kā bā tsi rakṣa hūm̐: e las mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba yi: drag po'i pho brang rim gsum me rlung 'khrugs: rno dbal 'khor lo brtsegs pa'i lte ba ru: hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ mtshan 'od 'bar bas: rgyal mchod 'gro ba'i don byas mthu stobs 'dus: ye shes mgon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi mthing: gri gug thod khrag ral gri kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin: padma nyi ma bdud bzhi'i steng du bzhugs: dur khrod chas gsol bya gcan sna tshogs 'phro: dbyings kyi yum chen e ka dzā ṭi ma: sngon mo gri thod 'dzin cing yab dang 'khril: dbus dang phyogs bzhir dbyings kyi rgyal mo lnga: mtshams bzhir las byed gdong can rje mo'i tshogs: shar du hūm̐ mdzad mgon po gri thod 'dzin: lho ru legs ldan gri thod bing chen bsnams: nub tu myur mdzad phyag drug gri thod dang: padma kha ṭwāṃ thod rnga mgo phreng 'dzin: byang du ma ning ru mtshon snying zhags bsnams: yab yum sras 'khor drag po'i chas dang ldan: sgo gsum bdud dang gshin rje sgrol ba'i ging: bar khyams las kyi mgon po chen po brgyad: sman mo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad las la rngams: phyi khyams dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu dang: sngags bdag bco brgyad dmod pa'i mtshon cha can: mu ran lha srin sde brgyad dmag gi dpung: shar lhor nag po stong dang sha za 'bum: nub byang ma mo bye ba gnod sbyin khri: ro kha ma gsum gsang ba'i mngags gzhug mdzad: bdud btsan klu gsum dgra la jag par chas: stobs ldan gtum drag bskal pa'i me rlung bzhin: rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyis byin brlabs shing: ye shes lnga yi dbang dang ldan par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: chos dbyings dur khrod me ri 'bar:

gnas yul chos 'khor thams cad nas: ye shes mgon po lcam dral dang: las kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas: dregs pa'i mgon po ma mo'i tshogs: bstan srung thams cad spyan 'dren na: myur ba nyid du gshegs su gsol: badzra sa ma ya dza: e ā ralli hriṃ hriṃ dza: hūm̐: dur khrod gnas mchog dam pa 'dir: dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs nas kyang: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru: khas blangs dam las ma 'da' zhig: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣṭhantu: oṃ badzra sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: rngam brjid rol pa drag po'i pho brang du: khrag gi char 'beb dug chu'i rba klong 'khrugs: dbang po'i tshogs bkram gsur chen sprin ltar gtibs: bskal pa'i me 'bar mkhris pa'i dri chab dang: gti mug sha yi gtor ma ri ltar brtsegs: 'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho chen po bskyil: zhe sdang rus pa don snying phung por spungs: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman dang sbyar: rkang chen dung dang thod rnga 'brug ltar ldir: gzung 'dzin dgra bgegs 'od gsal klong du bsgral: bde chen mnyam sbyor byang chub sems kyi sprin: gnyis med mnyam par rtogs pa'i mchod pa 'bul: thugs dam bskangs nas dgra bgegs myur du sgrol: oṃ ma hā arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai bidya shabda pañtsa rakta ba liṃ ta ma traṃ ru tra mā ra ya bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dharma dhā tu pū dza ho: hūm̐: dbyings las rol pa ye shes ma mgon tshogs: thugs rje'i sku sprul las mgon lcam dral dang: bstan srung dregs pa'i mgon po mthu stobs can: dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod:1$0000250 ting 'dzin rtse gcig dzap bzlas ni: 1$0000300oṃ ma hā kā lā ya shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi: e ṣa a pashtsi ma kā lo a yaṃ i daṃ ratna tra yā ya: a pa kā ri ṇaṃ ya di pra ti dzñā sma ra si ta dā: i daṃ duṣṭān kha kha khā hi khā hi: mā ra mā ra:

gṛhṇa gṛhṇa: bandha bandha: ha na ha na: da ha da ha: pa tsa pa tsa: di na me ke na hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐:1$0000250 thog ltar bzla zhing gtor ma 'bul: 1$0000300hūm̐: bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa: thugs rje brtse bas dgongs su gsol: nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa: 'gyod pas bshags so dag par mdzod:1$0000250 yig brgya bzlas shing mnyam par bzhag: 1$0000300 sa ma ya: ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu'i yi ge / bla ma ye shes mgon por 'dud:1$0000270 de nas sgrub pa'i rim pa ni:1$0000300 1$0000270dur khrod gtsug lag khang sogs la: stegs bu gru gsum brtsegs pa'i khar: dur khrod sa snas dkyil 'khor bri: sku gzugs 'bur ram bris pa dang: srog sngags 'khor lor bkod pa bcas: gri snying bla rdo phyag mtshan dang: mtshan ldan thod pa bcud kyis bkang: 'phyar ba'i dar chen sman rag gtor: mchod pa rgyan rnams rgyas par bsham: ting 'dzin gsal bar bsgoms nas su: 1$0000300bla ma'i sku yi 'od zer gyis: bdag gi dam tshig nyams chag sbyangs: dam can khros pa zhi bar mdzad: oṃ ma hā gu ru oṃ shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā: bde gshegs sku las 'od 'phros pas: dam can rnams kyi mthu rtsal skyed: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥbhrūm̐ puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā: yi dam rnams kyi sku las 'od: 'phros pas dam can dbang du byas: oṃ shrī he ru ka hrīḥb shaṃ ku ru ho: ye shes las byed ma mgon gyi: sku las 'od 'phros phrin las sgrub: oṃ ma hā kā la e ka dzā ṭi gu ṇa hṛ da hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ karma ma hā kā la trag raksha hūm̐ bhyo: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭān ma ma ru lu e dzaḥbhyo:1$0000270 bar ma chod par thog ltar bzla: phrin las thams cad myur du 'grub: sa ma ya: 1$0000300ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ me ri mched pa lta bu'i yi ge / ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈ thog ser 'tshubs pa lta bu'i yi ge / bla ma ye shes mgon por 'dud:1$0000270

las sbyor bstan srung phrin las ni: las kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas su: lho nub tu ni gsad khang bya: dgra bgegs zag rdzas nya bo bcas: ting 'dzin gsal bar bsgoms nas su: 1$0000300rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer ni: ye shes mgon po'i thugs kar phog: las kyi mgon po thams cad bskul: dregs pa'i mgon po rnams la phog: thams cad zhe sdang cher 'khrugs nas: sku las sprul pa'i pho nya ni: mthing nag mi bzad khro gtum can: lcags kyu zhags pa thogs pa yis: dgra bgegs rang dbang med par bkug: gzugs byang la ni bstim par bsam: 1$0000270'bod rbad gsad gsum sngags rnams bzlas:1$0000300 las mgon 'jigs su rung ba yis: gri gug dkar nag mtshams su brgyab: thun char phab pas bsad par bsam: tshe bsod mthu nus 'od zer bsdu: rnam shes a yig dbyings su spar:1$0000270 dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i phung po de: liṅga brgya rtsa ming rus bcas: drag po'i hom brtsegs me sbar la: me phung hom gzar 'dzin pa yi: dmar nag me yi lha bsgoms la: 1$0000300oṃ agni rā dza dgra bgegs dzwa la raṃ:1$0000270 zhun chen khrag dang sbyar te 'bul: 'bar ba'i dbus su khrom tshogs su: ma mgon lcam dral 'khor bcas bskyed: drag sngags bzla zhing brgya rtsa bsreg: me lha zor gyi lha la bstim: thal ba dang bcas zor du 'phang: 'bod rbad byas la gsad pas bsgral: grangs dang mnyam pa'i dgra bgegs 'chi: gsad pa las kyi mthar thug go: 1$0000300hūm̐: ye shes mgon po lcam dral dang: las kyi mgon po ma mo'i tshogs: dregs pa'i mgon po 'khor dang bcas: dgra bgegs byad ma lha srung dang: tshe bsod mthu nus lus srog sregs: lhag ma med par da lta bzhes:1$0000270 dgra bgegs bsregs pa'i thal ba mnan: 1$0000300hūm̐: rim pa dgu yi sa 'og nas: gshin rje'i mgon po 'chi bdag rnams: za skal dgra bgegs khyod la gtad: nam yang steng du ma gtang zhig:1$0000270

de ltar las kyi rjes bsdu'o: sa ma ya: 1$0000300ྈྈྈྈྈྈ gri gug phyag mtshan lta bu'i yi ge / ྈྈྈ bla ma ye shes mgon por 'dud: bsnyen sgrub 'dod pa'i gang zag la: gtor ma'i dbang bskur sbyin pa ni: gtor chen sku gsung thugs rten bsham: zhwa nag gos nag chas su zhugs: gtor ma lha ru bsgoms nas kyang: thod rnga rkang gling drag sngags ldir: yengs med lta ba'i ngang du bzhag: slob mas mtshon cha'i yon 'bul la: bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyis: bdag la brtse bar dgongs nas kyang: bdag la byin gyis brlab pa dang: sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang stsol: slob ma mgon po'i skur bsgoms nas: de yang mthing nag gri thod 'dzin: gtor ma lha yi gnas gsum nas: sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer 'phros: slob ma la ni thim par bsam: hūm̐: ye shes mgon po lcam dral gyis: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur zhing: las kyi ma mgon 'khor bcas kyis: mthu dang nus pa'i dngos grub stsol: dregs pa rnams kyis grogs mdzod cig: kā ya wā ka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sngags bzla spros med don la gnas: thun mong min la lha bstim zhing: dam tshig khas blangs gtang rag phul: rjes kyi bya ba spyi ltar bya: sku gsung thugs sgom rjes su gnang: bsnyen sgrub las la dbang ba 'o: e ma ho: de ltar ma mgon sgrub pa 'di: ma 'ongs nga yi rjes 'jug pa: rdo rje snying po'i bstan 'dzin pa'i: skyes bu mtha' nas mtha' ru 'byung: bshad dang sgrub pa'i sde mang po: chos 'khor chen po du ma 'byung: bar chad dgra bgegs 'dul ba dang: bstan pa srung thabs 'di nyid zab: kun gyis yal bar ma dor cig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ mtshon cha brag ri lta bu'i yi ge / gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: sprul pa'i gter chen mchog gyur gling pas rong rme dkar mo stag tshang gi gu ru'i gsang phug gong ma'i g.yas gdong nas spyan drangs pa'i mchong shog brda'i yig rigs mi 'dra ba drug las/
phrin las 'gro 'dul dbang gi gnas mchog ri bo dbang zhu'i snying po zla gam dbang chen phug tu gtan la phab pa'i yi ge pa ni padma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// /
